source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by white)

camera.motion: static (assumed: simulation camera fixed within clip; background is uniform white so no background features to verify, but boat hull bottom/size change smoothly with no jitter)
camera.perspective_cues: no ground plane, horizon or water visible (segmented). Boat seen in 3/4 view from slightly above (deck visible). Boat shrinks smoothly over the clip -> it recedes from the camera while moving left.

boat.description: red/pink-hulled fishing boat (trawler) with white/grey wheelhouse, tall mast with crossbar, black chimney/davit; the large object in the left-centre
boat.motion: translates leftwards (image -x) about 3.88 px/frame (centroid), nearly constant; hull bottom rises 632->617 px and hull width shrinks 258->226 px (receding from camera); mast crossbar visible frames 0-~4 and ~37-74 but edge-on in between (small yaw/rock)
boat.apparent_scale_change: hull_w ratio frame74/frame0 = 0.876; keel-to-mast-top height ratio ~ 0.927 (mast tip faint, +-8 px)
boat.reference_point: origin unknown; recorded bbox centre (ref_x, ref_y), mask centroid, hull bbox centre (hull_cx, hull_cy) and keel line (hull_y1). For a boat model the origin is most likely near the hull centre (hull_cx, hull_cy).

bird.description: small dark-brown flying bird (gull/eagle-like) with flapping wings, flies left to right at mast height (y ~370-400 px)
bird.motion: flies rightwards about 11.2 px/frame (bbox centre, noisy because of wing flapping), slight vertical undulation y 368-398 px; passes the boat's mast frames 10-13 (merged in mask, flagged occluded); leaves through right image edge frames 63-66, absent 67-74
bird.reference_point: bbox centre (ref_x, ref_y); centroid also given. Wingspan changes with flapping: use bbox_w/len_main_axis min and max for min/max wingspan.

static_objects: none: background removed by segmentation (uniform white); no ground, water or markings.

events.event: clip start; boat and bird both already moving (boat left, bird right)
bird reaches boat mast (touches mast in mask)
bird clears mast on its right side (overlap frames 10-13, bird crosses mast ~frame 11-12)
bird begins to be cut by right image edge
bird out of view for rest of clip
clip end; boat still moving left
